name: Rianne Van Rompaey
bio: Rianne Frida Loes Van Rompaey is a Dutch fashion model. Labeled as a top model by Vogue, she has appeared on the cover of Vogue Paris over 6 times.

credits.title: Forty Love
credits.overview: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.

credits.title: Faces
credits.overview: “ Starring Rianne Van Rompaey as herself, in a space between dream and reality, 'Faces' depicts Rianne's absurd journey to making it on time to a packed theatre's stage for a much anticipated performance she has conceived of.” - IMDb
